ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, within $\odot O$, $A$, $B$, and $C$ are three points on $\odot O$. If $\angle AOB=70^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle C$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given: $\angle AOB$ and $\angle ACB$ both subtend $\overset{\frown}{AB}$, and $\angle AOB=70^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle C=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOB=\boxed{35^\circ}$.
